title: Start Here
description: Begin with an overview, then explore a few different perspectives before choosing a research direction.

resources.title: AISafety.info
resources.description: An accessible collection of questions and answers covering the core ideas and debates in AI safety.

resources.title: 11 Essential Readings on AI Safety
resources.description: A reading list on AI risk and alignment from 80,000 Hours.

resources.title: Robert Miles — AI Safety
resources.description: Short explanatory videos on alignment concepts such as specification gaming, mesa-optimization, and corrigibility.

resources.title: Introduction to AI Safety, Ethics, and Society
resources.description: A free textbook surveying risks from advanced AI alongside relevant topics in machine learning, ethics, and governance.
resources.source: Dan Hendrycks / Center for AI Safety

title: Technical Research Directions
description: Explore approaches to understanding, evaluating, and guiding AI systems.

groups.title: Mechanistic Interpretability
groups.description: Understanding learned internal representations, features, and computational mechanisms in neural networks, especially transformer language models.

resources.title: Getting Started in Mechanistic Interpretability
resources.description: A practical guide to the background, tools, and first projects for learning mechanistic interpretability.

resources.title: Concrete Steps to Get Started
resources.description: An older practical guide to transformer interpretability; the author marks it as deprecated in favor of the newer guide.

resources.title: Transformer Circuits Thread
resources.description: A series of research articles on reverse-engineering the internal mechanisms of transformer language models.

resources.title: TransformerLens
resources.description: An open-source Python library for inspecting and intervening on the activations of transformer models.

resources.title: Zoom In: An Introduction to Circuits
resources.description: Olah et al. (2020). Argues that neural networks can be understood by studying features and the circuits connecting them.

groups.title: AI Evaluations & Auditing
groups.description: Evaluating AI capabilities, dangerous behavior, reliability, model monitoring, and alignment failures.

resources.title: Inspect
resources.description: An open-source framework for building and running evaluations of large language models.

resources.title: Model Evaluation for Extreme Risks
resources.description: Shevlane et al. (2023). Discusses how evaluations for dangerous capabilities and alignment can inform AI development and deployment decisions.

resources.title: Concrete Problems in AI Safety
resources.description: Amodei et al. (2016). Frames five practical research problems, including reward hacking, safe exploration, and robustness to distributional shift.

resources.title: Unsolved Problems in ML Safety
resources.description: Hendrycks et al. (2021). Organizes open problems into robustness, monitoring, alignment, and systemic safety.

groups.title: AI Control & Agentic Misalignment
groups.description: Research on preventing harmful behavior from potentially misaligned AI systems, including monitoring, oversight, and strategic deception.

resources.title: AI Control
resources.description: Research on safeguards against potentially misaligned AI systems.

resources.title: Risks from Learned Optimization in Advanced Machine Learning Systems
resources.description: Hubinger et al. (2019). Introduces mesa-optimization and the inner alignment problem.

resources.title: Alignment Faking in Large Language Models
resources.description: An empirical study of behavior that differs when a model believes it is being trained versus unmonitored.

groups.title: Alignment Methods & Scalable Oversight
groups.description: Techniques for training and supervising AI systems, including human feedback, AI feedback, preference learning, and oversight of increasingly capable models.

resources.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
resources.description: Bai et al. (2022). Trains a model to be harmless using a set of written principles and AI-generated feedback.

resources.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
resources.description: Ouyang et al. (2022). Applies reinforcement learning from human feedback to fine-tune large language models.

resources.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
resources.description: Christiano et al. (2017). Introduces learning a reward model from human comparisons of agent behavior.

title: Research Organizations & Blogs
description: Research groups and writers publishing work on AI safety. Inclusion does not imply affiliation with UEMK ASIA.

resources.title: Anthropic Research
resources.description: Research on alignment, interpretability, model evaluations, and safety.

resources.title: Anthropic Alignment Science Blog
resources.description: Empirical research on misalignment, auditing, evaluations, and oversight.

resources.title: Redwood Research
resources.description: Research on AI control, adversarial training, and alignment.

resources.title: Neel Nanda — Mechanistic Interpretability
resources.description: Technical guides, research explanations, and projects on mechanistic interpretability.

resources.title: METR — Research
resources.description: Research on AI capabilities, autonomy evaluations, monitoring, and risk assessment.

resources.title: Apollo Research
resources.description: Research on scheming, strategic deception, and monitoring in AI systems.

resources.title: AI Alignment Forum
resources.description: A forum for technical research discussion on AI alignment, including curated sequences for newcomers.

groups.title: Governance Research
groups.description: Reports and research on evidence, policy, and institutions.

resources.title: International AI Safety Report
resources.description: A report synthesizing the scientific evidence on the capabilities and risks of general-purpose AI, written with contributors from many countries.

resources.title: Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
resources.description: Research and publications on policy, institutions, and decision-making related to advanced AI.

groups.title: Career Guidance
groups.description: Perspectives on research and careers for reducing risks from AI.

resources.title: AI Safety Technical Research
resources.description: An overview of technical AI safety research as a career path.

resources.title: How to Work on Reducing AI Risks
resources.description: Career guidance for people interested in reducing risks from advanced AI.

resources.title: How to Get into AI Safety in Three Months
resources.description: Advice on building skills and exploring AI safety work.

resources.title: Preventing an AI-related catastrophe
resources.description: A long-form overview of arguments for prioritizing risks from advanced AI, with notes on technical and policy career paths.
